newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas shares seen little changed in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Caracas shares seen little changed in slow trading.

text.p: Shares on the Caracas Stock Exchange were seen little changed in thin trading with no news to move the market in either direction, brokers said.
"I think the market will have little volume and no defined tendency until the political and economic panorama is cleared up or there is new news," said Hector Perez of the Financorp brokerage.
Brokers said foreign investors were paying particular attention to the government's flagging privatization program.
The market's 19-share index fell 0.16 percent on Monday 4,593.56 in very slow trade.
